svg.aria-label: Middleman — names the middleman: Two blue prints in one block turn orange the instant the same wallet is found on both sides. On the #1 Uniswap v2 pair by transactions, 66.2 percent of the volume was 3 wallets buying back what they just sold inside one transaction — 29 round-trips; with those legs out an organic fill pays 15.5 basis points, not the 55.3 the tape implies. Route via Uniswap v2 / WETH, cap slippage at 0.65 percent.
svg.title: Middleman — 66.2% of the busiest Uniswap v2 pair is 3 wallets trading with themselves
